Estimated from what's visible on the tray: a glass of orange juice, two eggs, half an avocado, and one slice of whole-grain toast.

- Orange juice, about 200 ml: 90 kcal, 1.5 g protein, 21 g carbs, 0.4 g fat.
- Two eggs (they look sunny-side up or poached, with a little oil): 180 kcal, 12 g protein, 1 g carbs, 14 g fat.
- Avocado, about half a small one (roughly 70 g): 110 kcal, 1.4 g protein, 6 g carbs, 10 g fat.
- Toast, one slice of whole-grain bread: 100 kcal, 4 g protein, 17 g carbs, 1.5 g fat.

Together that comes to about 480 kcal served. The photo is taken before eating, so I can't see what will be left over. I assumed a small amount of leftover, about 10 kcal, and subtracted it to get the amount eaten.
